lines.en: label futabadorm35:
I knock on Futaba’s door and wait to see if there’s a response.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Futaba 的门，等着看有没有回应。

lines.en: She was still a little off the last time I checked the library, so I’m hoping that, at the very least, she’s awake tonight.
lines.zh: 上次我去图书馆看她时，她的状态还不太好，所以我希望她今晚至少是醒着的。

lines.en: : Sensei? Is that you?
lines.zh: : Sensei？是你吗？

lines.en: Oh good. It appears that she is.
lines.zh: 太好了。看来她确实醒着。

lines.en: : Yup. Did my strong, manly knocking noise give it away?
lines.zh: : 对啊。是我那充满男子气概的敲门声暴露的吗？

lines.en: : It’s more the fact that just no one else ever knocks in general...
lines.zh: : 倒不如说，平时根本没别人会敲门……

lines.en: : Does that mean I can come in?
lines.zh: : 那我可以进来吗？

lines.en: : Am I allowed to put a bra on first?
lines.zh: : 能让我先把胸罩穿上吗？

lines.en: scene black
: Sorry, Futaba. It was kind of hard to hear you out there.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Futaba。外面实在听不太清你说话。

lines.en: : You said “Come in, it’s open,” right?
lines.zh: : 你是说“进来吧，门没锁”，对吧？

lines.en: scene futabafingering1
: Well, I guess that answers that question.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我想这个问题算是解决了。

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. Did you need more time? I just couldn't seem to hear you from the hall.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。你还需要再准备一下吗？我在走廊里怎么都听不清你的声音。

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 是吗……

lines.en: : How are you feeling?
lines.zh: : 你身体怎么样？

lines.en: scene futabafingering2
: Wow, you're just getting right down to it, aren't you?
lines.zh: : 哇，你还真是直奔主题啊。

lines.en: : At least I didn’t wake you up this time.
lines.zh: : 至少这次我没把你吵醒。

lines.en: scene futabafingering3
: No. I guess you didn’t...
lines.zh: : 嗯，确实没有……

lines.en: : I’m still feeling a little out of it, but I’ll probably start getting better soon.
lines.zh: : 我还是有点晕乎乎的，不过应该很快就会好起来。

lines.en: : Rin’s been really helpful. I feel like if I stay...sick any longer that she’ll wind up going crazy and quitting the cafe to be my full-time caretaker.
lines.zh: : Rin 帮了我很多。我觉得如果我再……病下去，她肯定会疯掉，然后辞掉咖啡厅的工作来全职照顾我。

lines.en: : Is whatever you have really that bad? I was under the impression you were just overworked.
lines.zh: : 你这病真的有那么严重吗？我一直以为你只是太累了。

lines.en: : That’s the easiest way of putting it. Or at least the way that will make me feel less weird.
lines.zh: : 这么说最简单。或者说，这么说我才不会觉得自己很奇怪。

lines.en: : So I’d be really thankful...if you could just leave it at that for now.
lines.zh: : 所以如果你能……暂时就这样，我会很感激的。

lines.en: : Sure. It’s not really my business prying into your personal life anyway.
lines.zh: : 没问题。本来也不该由我来打探你的私事。

lines.en: scene futabafingering1
: Then you might want to stop barging into my room without my permission as well...
lines.zh: : 那你最好也别再不经我允许就闯进我的房间了……

lines.en: : Oh come on. You were going to let me in anyway. We both know that.
lines.zh: : 得了吧。你本来也会让我进去的。这一点我们心里都清楚。

lines.en: scene futabafingering4
: Obviously. But that doesn’t mean I’m not still embarrassed.
lines.zh: : 那是当然。但这不代表我就不觉得害羞了。

lines.en: : I’m surprised you have any embarrassment left in you after all of the things we’ve done.
lines.zh: : 我们做了那么多事之后，你居然还有害羞的余地，我挺意外的。

lines.en: jump futabafingeringx
label futabafingeringx:
scene futabafingering5
: I’m still surprised by just {i}how much{/i} we’ve done in the first place.
lines.zh: : 更让我意外的是，我们居然做了{i}那么多{/i}。

lines.en: : I was completely oblivious to boys until you showed up and started convincing me to touch your penis.
lines.zh: : 在你出现、开始说服我摸你那个之前，我对男孩子完全一窍不通。

lines.en: : In my defense-
lines.zh: : 我要为自己辩护——

lines.en: : In your defense what?
lines.zh: : 你为自己辩护什么？

lines.en: : ...I don’t know. I’ve got nothing.
lines.zh: : ……我不知道。我什么都说不出来。

lines.en: scene futabafingering6
: My poor innocence. Where has it gone?
lines.zh: : 我可怜的纯真啊。它去哪儿了？

lines.en: : You’ll always be innocent to me. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 在我眼里，你永远都是纯真的。别担心。

lines.en: scene futabafingering7
: I can’t tell if I like that or hate it. I don’t think I want to stay innocent forever.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己是喜欢还是讨厌这句话。我觉得我不想永远都那么纯真。

lines.en: : But at the same time, I don’t really think I’m ready to take things further either.
lines.zh: : 但同时，我也觉得自己还没准备好更进一步。

lines.en: : You can still be innocent even if we have sex.
lines.zh: : 就算我们做了，你也依然可以是纯真的。

lines.en: : Is this you trying to talk me into having sex with you? Because I don’t really understand the strategy if it is.
lines.zh: : 你这是在劝我和你上床吗？如果是的话，我真看不出这是什么策略。

lines.en: : Well, yes and no.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是也不是。

lines.en: : What I really mean is that my image of you is pretty much set in stone at this point.
lines.zh: : 我真正想说的是，我对你的印象到这一步基本已经定型了。

lines.en: : You’re surprisingly wholesome despite being a little deviant while you’re performing sex acts on me.
lines.zh: : 你意外地很纯情，尽管在对我做那些事的时候有点变态。

lines.en: scene futabafingering8
: D-Deviant?! I just do what you tell me to!
lines.zh: : 变、变态？！我只是照你说的做而已！

lines.en: : Yeah but you’ve always got this sly smile on like you think you’re in control even though you’re definitely not.
lines.zh: : 是吗，可你脸上总挂着那种狡黠的笑，一副一切尽在掌控的样子——明明根本不是。

lines.en: : I do not! That’s just my face!
lines.zh: : 我才没有！那只是我的长相！

lines.en: : No, your normal face is much more...well, normal.
lines.zh: : 不，你平时的脸要……正常多了。

lines.en: scene futabafingering9
: That just makes me sound boring...
lines.zh: : 那听起来我岂不是个无聊的人……

lines.en: : Sorry. I’m not great at describing things.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我不太会形容东西。

lines.en: scene futabafingering1
: Yeah...I figured that out a while ago.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我早就发现了。

lines.en: : But it’s okay. There are plenty of things I’m not great at. Like standing up for myself or...accepting help from others.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系。我不擅长的事多着呢。比如为自己出头，或者……接受别人的帮助。

lines.en: : That's a horrible combination of qualities.
lines.zh: : 这两种特质凑在一起还真是糟透了。

lines.en: : I hear that from Rin all the time...
lines.zh: : Rin 老这么说我……

lines.en: scene futabafingering10
: I’m getting better at writing, though! So maybe I’ll even have something else for you to read soon.
lines.zh: : 不过我写作进步了呢！所以也许很快你就有新东西可以读了。

lines.en: : More fantasy-slash-escapism stuff?
lines.zh: : 又是奇幻加逃避现实那套？

lines.en: : Maybe. Though my desire to escape isn’t exactly what it used to be now that I get to lean on you.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。不过既然现在可以依靠你了，我想逃避的那种心情已经不像以前那么强烈了。

lines.en: She doesn't lean on me at all.
lines.zh: 她根本没有依靠我。

lines.en: If she did, she wouldn’t have a problem with telling me what’s going on with her.
lines.zh: 如果她真的依靠我，就不会瞒着我她身上发生的事了。

lines.en: Her words lose impact when this thought crosses my mind.
lines.zh: 这个念头一冒出来，她的话就失去了分量。

lines.en: So many things cross my mind during times like these.
lines.zh: 这种时候，我脑子里总会掠过很多想法。

lines.en: But it’s near impossible discerning the meanings of any of them with these two massive mounds staring me in the face.
lines.zh: 但有两座雄伟的山峰正对着我的脸，我实在很难去分辨其中任何一个的含义。

lines.en: : When are you going to tell me your cup size? I need to report back to Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 你到底打算什么时候告诉我你的罩杯？我得回去向 Nodoka 汇报。

lines.en: : I know I’m winking at you, but is this really the best time to ask that?
lines.zh: : 我知道我是在朝你使眼色，但现在问这个真的合适吗？

lines.en: : I had to. I’m only human.
lines.zh: : 我非问不可。我也是个普通人啊。

lines.en: : But it’s definitely the easiest way.
lines.zh: : 但这肯定是最省事的办法。

lines.en: : Is that supposed to persuade me?! How are you so bad at this?!
lines.zh: : 这话是用来说服我的吗？！你怎么这么不会劝人啊？！

lines.en: scene futabafingering13

lines.zh: : 我……告诉你它们有多大……但我不想你对我做什么……

lines.en: : I’m still not feeling great and...I don’t know if my body would even be up to it...
lines.zh: : 我现在身体还是不太舒服……而且……我不知道我的身体受不受得了……

lines.en: : And also it’s late and...I wouldn’t want to make too much noise and...yeah...there are just a lot of reasons to not do anything.
lines.zh: : 而且已经很晚了……我也不想闹出太大动静……而且……嗯……总之就是有一大堆理由不该做。

lines.en: : Is there anything I can say to effectively persuade you since my other methods clearly aren’t working?
lines.zh: : 既然我别的办法显然都没用，那我说什么才能有效说服你呢？

lines.zh: : 那你要不要就……闭上眼睛？

lines.zh: : 因为你为 Rin、为我、为你认识的每一个人做了那么多，你值得。

lines.en: : You’re always so focused on giving that the idea of taking anything in any form probably confuses you or scares you or something like that.
lines.zh: : 你总是一门心思地付出，所以“接受”这件事——不管以什么形式——大概都会让你困惑，或者害怕，之类的。

lines.en: : And I want to give {i}you{/i} something for once.

lines.zh: : 我怎么会喜欢上像你这么强势的人啊？！

lines.zh: : 就像我会喜欢上像你这么拘谨的人一样。
